design_rationale: The user requested a light site with black text, navy/cobalt, and red accents. Archetype 4 (Swiss & High Contrast) adapted for premium services is perfect here. It creates an aura of authority, precision, and trust—essential for high-end appliance repair (Liebherr, Bertazzoni). We will use deep navy for trust/structure, bright cobalt for interactive elements, and sharp red for urgent CTAs or alerts. The layout will rely on generous white space, strict grids, and high-quality photography.

critical_instructions_for_main_agent: DO NOT use Inter or standard sans fonts for headings. Use Outfit for Headings and Manrope for body text.
For the Brand Logos Bar, DO NOT use image placeholders. Use typographical representations of the brand names (e.g., `PANASONIC`) using `react-fast-marquee`.
Use square/sharp corners (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`) for a premium, authoritative Swiss-design feel.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
For the multi-step scheduling modal, use a clean state-driven wizard layout inside a Shadcn Dialog. It should generate a mock OS number on success.
The Customer Portal requires a dedicated layout with sidebar navigation, separating it from the main marketing site.
